title: 1D Wavetable Scanning
idiom: two-colour Bauhaus screenprint, a lamp scanning a row of wave panes
hero_prompt: Two-colour Bauhaus screenprint in deep blue and orange on cream, hand-made on paper, flat and graphic with visible ink texture, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field: a long row of thin upright translucent glass panes standing one behind another along a single straight rail, each pane painted with one single wavy line whose shape changes gradually from a smooth round swell on the nearest pane to a sharp jagged zigzag on the farthest, and a small sliding carriage with a glowing lamp halfway along the rail, lighting the one pane it stands beside. Generous empty cream space.
icon_prompt: Screenprint emblem, a flat single-colour deep blue silhouette on a cream ground, no shading or gradients: three upright panes in a row, each holding one wave line that changes from a round swell to a square step, with a bold orange triangular pointer beneath the middle pane. Bold, high-contrast, no fine linework, reads clearly at 24 pixels.
